remarks: Welcome to this modern 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath condo rental offering comfort and convenience. The home features hardwood floors andan updated kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. The favorable open layout includes a working wood-burning fireplace and sliders leading to a private deck, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Additional features include central airconditioning, abundant closet space, attic storage, and the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. The complex also offers an in-ground pool for residents to enjoy. Parking includes reserved and visitor spaces, providing easy and convenient access. Carefreeliving at its best.
